assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves Syndrome
assertions.quote: This is known as Stewart-Treves syndrome, or cutaneous lymphangiosarcoma secondary to longstanding lymphedema.

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves Syndrome
assertions.quote: The most well-known risk factor is radiation therapy for the treatment of other malignancies.

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves Syndrome
assertions.quote: Chronic lymphedema also predisposes to cutaneous angiosarcoma, whether it be due to lymphadenectomy, Milroy disease (hereditary lymphedema), or chronic infection.

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves Syndrome
assertions.quote: Other risk factors that have been mentioned in the literature include exposure to arsenic and polyvinyl chloride, as well as previous herpes zoster and vascular malformation sites.
